CHAPTER.VERS: Hallelujah. Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, That delights greatly in his commandments.
His seed will be mighty on earth: The generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endures forever.
To the upright there rises light in the darkness: [He is] gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends; He will maintain his cause in judgment.
For he will never be moved; The righteous will be had in everlasting remembrance.
He will not be afraid of evil news: His heart is fixed, trusting in Yahweh.
His heart is established, he will not be afraid, Until he sees [his desire] on his adversaries.
He has dispersed, he has given to the needy; His righteousness endures forever: His horn will be exalted with honor.
The wicked will see it, and be grieved; He will gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked will perish.
